profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | Java | Spring Boot | React | Next.js | React Native | Node.js | AWS | REST APIs | Microservices | PostgreSQL | Enterprise Applications
profile.summary:
Full Stack Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience designing, developing, and modernizing enterprise web and mobile applications using Java, Spring Boot, React, Next.js, React Native, Node.js, TypeScript, and AWS.

Throughout my career, I have contributed to enterprise software projects across consulting and technology organizations, building scalable backend services, secure RESTful APIs, responsive user interfaces, cloud-based applications, and modern software solutions.

I enjoy solving complex technical problems, improving application performance, modernizing legacy systems, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in Agile environments.

Core Technologies:
• Java
• Spring Boot
• React
• Next.js
• React Native
• Node.js
• TypeScript
• AWS
• PostgreSQL
• REST APIs
• Microservices

positions.title: Java Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

• Developed and maintained enterprise web and mobile solutions using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, Express.js, React, Next.js, React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
• Designed and implemented secure RESTful APIs and microservices for data processing, authentication, authorization workflows, and frontend-to-backend integrations using JWT, OAuth 2.0, and Spring Security.
• Built reusable, responsive UI components and cross-platform mobile features, improving maintainability, usability, and consistency across enterprise applications.
• Developed cloud-ready services and integrations using AWS technologies, including Amazon S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and IAM, while supporting secure configuration and operational monitoring.
• Designed and optimized persistence layers using JPA, Hibernate, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB; troubleshot complex queries, mappings, and application-level data issues.
• Supported enterprise application modernization initiatives by migrating legacy Java/J2EE applications to Spring Boot architectures while maintaining JSP, Servlets, Spring Tags, and Hibernate integrations.
• Deployed and supported enterprise applications using IBM WebSphere and IBM RAD; diagnosed production and deployment issues through profiling, logging, debugging, and performance tuning.
• Integrated Jenkins CI/CD pipelines and Git/Bitbucket workflows for automated builds, deployments, code reviews, and controlled release management.
• Participated in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, technical reviews, and defect resolution to deliver stable software releases aligned with client requirements.
• Developed and maintained secure authentication and authorization workflows using JWT, OAuth 2.0, Spring Security, and enterprise access control practices.
• Implemented reusable frontend components using React, Next.js, and TypeScript, improving maintainability and consistency across multiple modules.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · Spring MVC · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Spring Framework · Java

positions.title: Java/Javascript/ServiceNow Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

• Configured and customized ServiceNow modules including Incident, Problem, Change, Discovery, CMDB, Knowledge, Project, Reporting, SLAs, and Service Portal.
• Developed business rules, UI policies, client scripts, and workflows using JavaScript to improve platform functionality and user experience.
• Collaborated with business analysts to gather technical requirements, document business processes, and estimate implementation efforts.
• Created manual and automated test cases using Automated Test Framework (ATF) to improve platform quality and validate system functionality.
• Participated in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, and deployment planning while collaborating with cross-functional teams.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot platform issues, support production deployments, and deliver scalable ServiceNow solutions aligned with business and technical requirements.

positions.title: Java Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Responsibilities:

• Designed, developed, tested, and supported Java/J2EE enterprise applications using Spring Boot, React, Node.js, RESTful APIs, and microservices architecture.
• Implemented persistence layers using JPA, Hibernate, Spring JDBC, Oracle, and Cassandra; consumed JSON/XML services using GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE operations.
• Utilized Apache Kafka for real-time data streaming and worked with JUnit, Selenium, SonarQube, Kibana, Gradle, Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, and JIRA.
• Refactored responsive UI components, resolved deployment and production defects, and collaborated with cross-functional teams on technical delivery and production support.
• Designed and implemented scalable RESTful APIs and microservices using Spring Boot to support enterprise applications and secure backend services.
• Participated in Agile/Scrum ceremonies, code reviews, and collaborative development efforts to deliver high-quality software solutions within project timelines.
• Optimized application performance by debugging production issues, refactoring existing code, and improving maintainability through clean architecture and object-oriented design principles.
positions.insights: Skills: Spring Boot · Spring Framework · Angular · Java · Hibernate · Software Development · JavaScript · React.js
